mapper.select: SELECT u.sys_user_id AS friendID, u.user_name AS friendName, COALESCE(bf.nickname, u.user_nickname) AS nickname, u.user_avatar AS avatar, u.is_deleted AS isDeleted, bf.category_id AS categoryID FROM biz_user u INNER JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN user_id = #{userId} THEN friend_id ELSE user_id END AS friend_id FROM biz_user_friend WHERE status = 1 AND (user_id = #{userId} OR friend_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY CASE WHEN user_id = #{userId} THEN friend_id ELSE user_id END ) f ON u.sys_user_id = f.friend_id LEFT JOIN biz_friend bf ON bf.creator_id = #{userId} AND bf.sys_friend_id = u.sys_user_id
